text:
Jared: Hi all — I handed in my resignation this morning. Last official day: 2026-05-20. Two quick asks: confirm benefits cutoff/COBRA timing and help with device return + a short KT window.

Mina: Thanks for flagging, Jared. Benefits stay active through your last day (2026-05-20 23:59 PT). COBRA notice will be emailed within ~10 business days after your offboard, and you'll have 60 days to enroll from that notice. I'll start the offboard ticket and add the checklist.

Jared: Appreciate it. I have one service account (ci-runner-03) and a personal external HDD I want shipped home. Also want 2 hours overlap the week before for pairing.

IT Bot: Standard deprovision timeline: Slack/SSO disabled EOD on last day, building access disabled 09:00 PT the following business day. Service keys must be scheduled for rotation if needed. To list keys run: 

```
redwood-cli keys list --owner jared --json
```

Mina: We can request a 48-hour access extension for documentation-only tasks by exception. Do you want that?

Jared: Yes please — extend through 2026-05-22 18:00 PT for the recorded KT and to hand over ci-runner-03. I'll add rotation steps in the runbook.

IT Bot: Noted. We'll tentatively allow SSO and keycard access until 2026-05-22 18:00 PT. Service key ci-runner-03: mark as "handoff" and we'll perform staged rotation at 2026-05-22 16:00 PT after new key validation. Please paste the key ID here.

Jared: Key ID: abc123-ci-runner-03. Also uploading a 12-min Loom and a 1-page priority list to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/jared-offboard.

Mina: Exit interview options: 2026-05-25 morning or 2026-05-26 afternoon. Which works? We'll also send the separation survey link after the interview.

Jared: 5/25 morning works. For device return: I'll drop laptop at HQ mailroom on my last day. Can we get a prepaid label for the external HDD?

People Ops: Prepaid label for personal items: yes. We'll attach instructions and label link to the offboard task. Laptop return: drop at HQ mailroom or schedule pickup via internal mail.

Payroll Bot: Final pay + accrued PTO: processed on the next payroll run per policy. If you have any bonus or commission details to settle, flag them in the offboard form by 2026-05-10 to ensure inclusion. For international bank transfers, confirm bank details in Workday by 2026-05-10.

Jared: Done — I'll fill the form today. One more: can we export my channel pins and a short snippet of important threads for the KT?

Mina: Yes — request channel export and we'll include it in the KT packet. Please pin any final docs now.

IT Bot: Reminder to rotate any personal credentials from home dir before returning device. Quick checklist we recommend running: 

```
# list user-owned tokens
redwood-cli auth tokens --owner jared --show-ids
# export pinned messages
redwood-cli slack export --user jared --pins
```

Jared: Will run those today and update the runbook. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

Mina: Offboard task created: https://tasks.redwood.com/ops/offboard-1765439999. We'll post the shipping label and final checklist there. :white_check_mark:

Jared: Appreciate it.
